title: How China Is Aiding Kazakh Efforts to Become Hyper Modern
gist: Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev capped a Shanghai trip by speaking at the opening of the 2026 World Artificial Intelligence Conference, praising China's AI progress and restating Kazakhstan's bid to be a regional digital-trade hub. The visit produced more than $15 billion in signed deals across digital infrastructure, transport and the security sector. (Note: the available text is a short opening excerpt rather than the full article.)

insights.claim: Kazakhstan and China signed deals worth more than $15 billion covering digital infrastructure, transport and the security sector around President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev's July 2026 Shanghai visit.
insights.speaker: Albert Otkjær
insights.so_what: A concrete size marker for Chinese tech and infrastructure penetration in Central Asia; the security-sector component is the most strategically sensitive line item.
